# Dental Data · Software in a Box

> Federated dental health data space for Europe, starting in Spain and the Netherlands, prepared for the European Health Data Space (EHDS; EEDS in Spanish). Software in a Box is looking for technology partners (ideally Microsoft Azure partners) and for the first dental chains and insurers.

## Pages
- [Europe · Partners and markets](https://dentaldata.softwareinabox.eu/en/): European hub in English: product, five markets compared (Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Denmark), France, Italy and Portugal being studied, partner programme
- [España · Piloto](https://dentaldata.softwareinabox.eu/es/): Spanish market (43,672 dentists, 97% paid by patients, chain consolidation), federated solution on Microsoft Azure, EHDS timeline, pilot with a Spanish chain or insurer before March 2027, FAQ (Spanish)
- [Nederland · Partnerprogramma](https://dentaldata.softwareinabox.eu/nl/): market (9,555 dentists, ~30% of practices closed to new patients, 500+ private-equity practices), solution, proposal, roadmap to March 2029 (Dutch)
- [België · Institutionele alliantie](https://dentaldata.softwareinabox.eu/nl-be/): Belgian market in Dutch (8,479 dentists, RIZIV/INAMI reimbursement €1.6bn in 2025, Health Data Agency), complement to RIZIV, institutional alliance, roadmap
- [Belgique · Alliance institutionnelle](https://dentaldata.softwareinabox.eu/fr-be/): Belgian market in French (same content as the Dutch page)
- [Deutschland · Partner für PVS und MVZ](https://dentaldata.softwareinabox.eu/de/): German market (43,663 dentists, ePA mandatory in dental practices since 1 Oct 2025, FDZ Gesundheit, GeDIG, iMVZ 30.4%), complement to ePA/FDZ for practice software vendors and MVZ (German)
- [Danmark · Institutionel alliance](https://dentaldata.softwareinabox.eu/da/): Danish market (4,964 dentists, free care 0-21, SCOR register since 1972, adults ≈15% subsidy, Digital Sundhed Danmark), extending the SCOR logic to adults, institutional alliance (Danish)


## Documents
- [Tandheelkundige gezondheidsdataruimtes in Europa · Vergelijkend onderzoek (PDF, NL)](https://dentaldata.softwareinabox.eu/docs/tandheelkundige-gezondheidsdataruimtes-europa-ehds.pdf): comparative study of Spain, Belgium, the Netherlands, Denmark and Germany, November 2026
- [Dental health data spaces in Europe · Comparative study (PDF, EN)](https://dentaldata.softwareinabox.eu/docs/dental-health-data-spaces-europe-ehds.pdf): English version of the same study, November 2026
- [Dental Data: Europe's Invisible Opportunity (PDF, EN)](https://dentaldata.softwareinabox.eu/docs/dental-data-es-nl-presentation-en.pdf): partnership presentation
